svg.aria-label: GPS L1 carrier-to-noise readings against elevation for the SkyTraq PX1105R and the u-blox NEO-M8T on the same outdoor antenna, one mark per satellite per two minutes, with the median of each elevation band.
svg.text: SkyTraq PX1105R, one satellite over 2 min
u-blox NEO-M8T, one satellite over 2 min
Same outdoor antenna, 20 min each, back to back (29 Sep 2026); no transmitter. Each receiver reads on its own scale.
